title: DFSMSdss ADRDSSU: a DUMP and a RESTORE command with a continued DATASET(INCLUDE(...)) filter
shapes: BDLD jcl/BDLDUT4.jcl DMP010: EXEC PGM=ADRDSSU, SYSIN holds DUMP DATASET(INCLUDE(PROD.BDLD.**)) - continued, OUTDDNAME(DROUT)
BDLD jcl/BDLDUT4.jcl RST020: EXEC PGM=ADRDSSU, SYSIN holds RESTORE DATASET(INCLUDE(PROD.BDLD.**)) - continued, INDDNAME(DRIN)
asserts: Each command in the inline SYSIN stream is one jcl_utility_cards fact with utility ADRDSSU, dd SYSIN, verb DUMP or RESTORE and its operands with the continuation hyphen dropped and the two lines joined; the continued command is one fact, not two. The DD named by OUTDDNAME / INDDNAME (DROUT, DRIN) is an ordinary jcl_dds fact of the step. ADRDSSU is system supplied: no program edge into the estate. The data set group PROD.BDLD.** is a filter in an operand, not a dataset reference.

citations.quote: With the DUMP command, you can dump DASD data to a basic sequential data set, a large format sequential data set or an extended format sequential data set.
With the RESTORE command, you can restore data to DASD volumes from DFSMSdss-produced dump volumes, which are identified with the INDDNAME keyword.
